name: auth-flows
description: Complete authentication flows including registration, email verification, password reset
features: Secure credential storage for Tauri desktop apps (OS keychain via keyring)
Tauri IPC commands, login and register forms (desktop part is Tauri-only; Electron apps are skipped)
note: Add-ons are installed via 'gpp add' command, not 'gpp template install'. They add files to existing platform directories.
